accounts.mine.sql: SELECT member_id, tenant_id, points, tier, status FROM loyalty_accounts WHERE member_id = ? AND tenant_id = ?

rewards.get.sql: SELECT id, stock, min_tier, cost FROM rewards WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?

redemptions.today.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM redemptions WHERE member_id = ? AND created_at > ?

statements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM redemptions WHERE member_id = ? AND created_at > ?
UPDATE loyalty_accounts SET points = points - ? WHERE member_id = ? AND tenant_id = ? AND status = 'active' AND points >= ?
UPDATE rewards SET stock = stock - ? WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ? AND stock >= ?
INSERT INTO redemptions (id, member_id, reward_id, quantity, points, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
